cases.name: repeated pronoun
cases.input: I I I think the build is ready
cases.expected: I think the build is ready
cases.source: push-to-talk dictation with a false start; tier A collapses at two

cases.name: repeated article and verb
cases.input: we need to to check the the file
cases.expected: we need to check the file
cases.source: common ASR stutter on function words

cases.name: filler prepass plus tiered duplicates
cases.input: so um the the plan is is ready
cases.expected: so the plan is is ready
cases.source: tiny filler prepass runs; tier B keeps the grammatical is is

cases.name: ordinal stutter collapses at two
cases.input: so first first the text disfluency stage
cases.expected: so first the text disfluency stage

cases.name: three repeats become one
cases.input: that that that is the point
cases.source: tier B word reaches its three-repeat threshold

cases.name: ordinary prose is untouched
cases.input: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
cases.expected: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

cases.name: legitimate doubles survive
cases.input: we had had enough and that that works
cases.expected: we had had enough and that that works
cases.source: had had and that that are grammar, not stutter

cases.name: two independent tier A runs
cases.input: the the file and we we know
cases.source: two independent runs in one line

cases.name: repeated three word phrase
cases.input: check the tests check the tests now
cases.source: adjacent repeated phrase collapses to its first occurrence

cases.name: three repeated phrases collapse to one
cases.input: check the tests check the tests check the tests
cases.source: phrase collapse repeats until no adjacent copy remains

cases.name: number words are never collapsed
cases.input: twenty twenty-six was a good year
cases.expected: twenty twenty-six was a good year
cases.source: a repeated number word can be a year or a count

cases.name: emails and paths are boundaries
cases.source: code-like tokens and emails are never treated as stutter

cases.name: newlines and list items are preserved
cases.input:
first item
- the the second
- third
cases.source: line structure must survive the pass

cases.name: filler prepass can be disabled
cases.source: settings opt out of even the small filler pass

cases.name: phrase collapse can be disabled
cases.input: we need to we need to go
cases.expected: we need to we need to go
cases.source: settings keep every repeated phrase for the model

cases.name: tier thresholds can be raised
cases.input: the the cat and the the the dog
cases.expected: the the cat and the dog
cases.source: a two-repeat tier A word survives when the threshold is three
